name: telefon-ai-phone
description: PM2 runner for the SIP + Gemini AI desk phone

scripts.start: echo Starting AI phone with PM2... && npx pm2 start ecosystem.config.cjs --update-env
scripts.stop: echo Stopping AI phone... && npx pm2 stop ai-phone
scripts.restart: echo Restarting AI phone... && npx pm2 restart ai-phone --update-env
scripts.delete: echo Removing AI phone from PM2... && npx pm2 delete ai-phone
